back_text: 50 bold, simple Christmas pictures made for small hands: Santa, snowmen, reindeer, gingerbread, puppies, presents and more.
Thick outlines and big spaces make colouring easy for toddlers and preschoolers. Every picture is printed on its own page with a blank back, so markers won't bleed through.
A perfect stocking stuffer for ages 2 to 5.

description_html:
Big, simple Christmas pictures for little hands.

50 bold and easy holiday designs with thick outlines and large spaces: perfect first colouring for toddlers and preschoolers.

  • 50 single-sided pages (blank backs, no bleed-through)
  • Santa, snowman, reindeer, elves, gingerbread house, puppies, presents and more
  • Each picture is labelled with a big hollow word to colour too
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages

A great stocking stuffer for ages 2-5.
